description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-user-event-trend --instance-id waf-cn-7mz2797x000 --cluster-id 428 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekzwwk0000cv5i --event-scope ip --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
